question: 63 years ago today, Jim Brown passed Joe Perry to become the NFL's career rushing leader, midway through only his 7th season. In his 9-season career, how many times did Brown lead the NFL in rushing?
answer_detail: His only miss was 1962, when Green Bay's Jim Taylor took the rushing title. Brown never missed a game and retired at 30 after the 1965 season with 12,312 yards.
